# arianet_network (Data Source)

One existing private network, by `id`, `name` or `label_selector`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arianet_network" "private" {
  label_selector = "env=prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Network ID.
- `label_selector` (String) Label selector that must match exactly one network.
- `name` (String) Network name.

### Read-Only

- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter.
- `ip_range` (String) IP range.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `project_id` (Number) Project.
- `routes` (Attributes List) Routes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))
- `status` (String) Status.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `destination` (String) Destination.
- `gateway` (String) Next hop.


<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) Router address.
- `id` (Number) Subnet ID.
- `ip_range` (String) Range.
- `status` (String) Status.
